question: Who among the following was the first Indian to win the Miss World beauty pageant?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Reita Faria**__.

__
 
• **Reita Faria is an Indian physician, former model, and winner of the Miss World 1966 pageant**__.

 __
 
• Reita Faria is a beauty pageant titleholder who won the Miss World title in 1966, making her the first Asian woman to win the event.
 
• Born in Bombay to Goan parents, she became the first Asian woman to win a beauty pageant.
